narratives.body: RotoBaller reports that Max Strus has been ruled out for the LA Clippers' road trip.
narratives.headline: Max Strus: ruled out

narratives.body: Yahoo Sports reports that the LA Clippers dedicated their opening-night win to suspended owner Steve Ballmer, stating they are still fighting for him.
narratives.headline: LA Clippers: dedication to Steve Ballmer

narratives.body: NBC Sports reports that Darius Acuff Jr. had a brutal debut against the LA Clippers, while Keegan Murray struggled in the same matchup.
narratives.headline: LA Clippers: Acuff debut and Murray struggles
